historical_reviews.deepseek: Useful storage inventory but omits the explicit PCI identity/link acceptance.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Combines both storage identity and PCIe requirements without treating a grep keyword as authoritative identity.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row432 updates E1.S firmware; row434 validates E1.S sensors over in-band and OOB IPMI.

original_test_intent: Verify every expected E1.S device is correctly enumerated and mapped in OS/PCIe inventory, has the approved vendor/device identity and negotiates the required Gen4 speed and lane width for its slot.
original_method: Start from the authoritative E1.S serial/model/namespace/controller/BDF/physical-slot map; collect lsblk/nvme list/id-ctrl and lspci -Dnnvv for exact BDFs; record LnkCap and LnkSta speed/width plus upstream port; distinguish theoretical lane table from measured bandwidth; compare expected width per slot, link downtraining and AER/log delta; do not rely on grep keyword or mutable namespace numbering.
manual_activity: Storage/platform owner provides the fitted-drive/slot map and expected lane width; operator may confirm physical labels.
safety_requirements: Do not infer slot from /dev order
Capture full lspci blocks rather than grep fragments
Preserve logs and stop on disappearance/AER

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its NVMe identity collection is relevant but fails the source PCI vendor/device and link requirement.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: For each serial-mapped controller, run full `nvme id-ctrl` and exact `lspci -Dnnvv -s <BDF>`; extract but retain complete evidence for LnkCap/LnkSta.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Vendor/device ID, 16.0 GT/s and x1/x2/x4/x8/x16 width table retained as the source oracle.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a serial-to-namespace-to-controller-to-BDF-to-slot table with capable/current link attributes and explicit variance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity joins, upstream path, capable-versus-negotiated distinction and log/AER evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: NVMe enumeration alone cannot prove PCIe Gen4 speed/width; theoretical bandwidth is not a performance result.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BDF and namespace order are dynamic, and the source bandwidth table assumes ideal encoding/line rate rather than workload throughput.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines fitted drive count, slot lane width, whether lower negotiated state is allowed for empty/upstream constraints and the authoritative bandwidth interpretation.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek is incomplete but its storage inventory is compatible supporting evidence; no direct source identity contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete; execution gated by project-specific drive/slot and expected PCIe width/identity data.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row433 Wistron-Storage-00068-V002: provide every E1.S serial/model/namespace/controller/BDF/physical-slot/root-port map, expected vendor/device/subsystem IDs, capable/current Gen4 speed and lane width per slot, allowed downtraining and whether the bandwidth table is theoretical only.

review_improvement: Connects NVMe and PCI identities to physical slots and prevents theoretical bandwidth from being reported as measured performance.
independent_technical_reasoning: A drive can appear in lsblk while its link is downtrained, and a correct BDF without serial mapping can be the wrong slot. The validation therefore must join the NVMe controller identity to exact PCI path and compare both capable and current link attributes.
